metadata.title: Will Anyone Buy Slate Auto’s Cheap EV Truck With Hand-Crank Windows and No Radio? - WSJ

content.text:
A new automotive startup is betting that Americans are so fed up with high car prices they will consider buying a two-seat, all-electric pickup truck with hand-crank windows and no radio.
Slate Auto, a Michigan-based carmaker backed by Amazon.com AMZN 1.32%increase; up pointing triangle founder Jeff Bezos, is racing to begin production later this year of its first model: an overtly spartan, compact truck that will start at $24,950, the company said on Wednesday. Trucks like these have been missing from U.S. roads for over a decade.
